name: Thumbnails rendered by the backend for templates, models and textures
body:
# Thumbnails

`lantern_editor_thumbnail(kind, name, size)` renders a template, a model or a texture off-screen with a fixed
three-quarter camera and writes a PNG into a cache directory (`<cache>/lantern-editor/thumbnails/`), returning its
path; the panel shows it with `<image src>`. Rendered lazily on first request and reused while the source is unchanged
(mtime). A texture thumbnail is the PNG itself, resized.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27 for templates: lantern_editor_thumbnail renders each template through the GpuRenderer, shown by a thumbnail:<id> viewport renderer per card (D-039). Model and texture thumbnails wait on the game having model assets; follow-up card.

questions.text: Should thumbnails reach the UI as PNG files in a cache directory shown by `<image src>`, or should Chaos's `<image handle>` (a runtime texture handle) be wired through penumbra-ui-backend so no files are written?
questions.recommendation: A: PNG files in a cache directory now (it works with the stack as it is, and the cache is useful for a future asset database); wiring <image handle> is a separate backend card.
